applicabilityBasis.summary: FXD targets one dollar through collateralized minting, debt repayment and arbitrage. Reviewed terms do not establish an identifiable issuer's obligation to redeem holders for a fixed amount of national-currency monetary value; protocol collateral release and stablecoin swaps do not establish that obligation. General dollar use nevertheless prevents a conclusive non-payment-token classification.

references.label: GENIUS Act: monetary value, payment stablecoin and effective-date definitions

genius.notes: No legal issuing entity or fixed-dollar issuer redemption undertaking was verified. Fathom DAO governance and upgradeable contracts are not themselves proof of statutory exemption. No named GENIUS authorization was located; this is not a finding of non-compliance. Implementation proposals and Treasury state-certification procedures do not authorize FXD.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The checked disclosures and regulator sources did not locate a named FXD or Fathom GENIUS approval, public official application, state qualification, foreign registration or issuer-announced pathway. NYDFS licensing and a Greenlist are not GENIUS authorization registers. This bounded negative review is not proof that no private application exists or a finding of illegality.
